# CPH2745_17.0.0.102(EX01)

> 官方更新日志 · 来源: 官方 changelog 页面
> OTA 指纹: `CPH2745_11.A.75_1750_202610181120`
> 原文: https://gauss-componentotamanual.allawnofs.com/remove-637db76f8be69531b9756bc89b6694f2/component-ota/26/10/22/809da45c63ea4f6598ad1c9b53b39f7b.html

### Fluid design. Smooth in motion, vivid by nature.

Introduces an all-new fluid design, crafted for seamless interactions. Smooth in motion, vivid by nature. With seamlessly integrated state transitions, gentle motion rhythms, and lively feedback, the fluid design makes every interaction feel natural.
Adds responsive light effects that balance readability, transparency, and visual aesthetics in a lightweight, friendly, rounded design.
Adds fluid animations. Screen and element transitions now feature fluid merging effects, creating seamless connections between elements and more natural transitions between states.
Adds a flexible feedback system that enables interface elements to naturally stretch, compress under pressure, and rebound dynamically in response to user interactions, while light effects actively respond to user intent and interface changes to convey status, feedback, and guidance through light, making every interaction feel more responsive and creating a more natural, vivid experience.
Introduces the next-generation Luminous Rendering Engine with a new fused rendering architecture that renders light effects and the user interface together, delivering greater rendering efficiency and more refined, seamless fluid animations and visuals.
Adds a fluid clock effect that seamlessly carries the clock across the Always-On Display, Lock screen, and Home screen, creating a natural, cohesive unlocking experience.
Improves the Lock screen swipe-up unlock animation. App icons now animate into view with the fluid clock as a visual anchor, creating a seamless transition from the Lock screen to the Home screen.
Adds a downward collapse effect for Lock screen notifications, allowing notification cards to stack naturally, and improves the progressive transitions and swipe-rebound animations for notification display changes.
Adds responsive behavior to the Lock screen clock font, dynamically adjusting its size based on notification content while ensuring readability at the minimum size.
Improves the visuals and animations of Lock screen widgets, bottom shortcuts, and Live Space capsules, with a new flexible feedback system applied to these elements.
Improves the Lock screen password keypad visuals by optimizing the progressive entry animation and introducing a flexible feedback system for more responsive interactions.
Introduces a new Quick Settings design with responsive light effects for tap interactions, providing more vivid feedback, and improves the visuals and animations on certain secondary pages.
Redesigns the notification drawer with a lighter, more translucent card design, enhancing information contrast and readability. Adds responsive light effects for tap interactions, making the feedback more vivid.
Improves the transition animation between the notification drawer and Quick Settings by introducing a sequential motion effect and dynamically adjusting element movement based on gesture focus and swipe speed, making transitions more responsive, natural, and fluid.
The Sublime Grandeur theme wallpapers now display real-time local weather, so you can check the latest weather information directly from the Home screen and Lock screen.
Adds Lock screen style switching for Flux themes, allowing you to freely switch between clock, graphic-and-text, and photo frame styles to easily create a personalized Lock screen (available for select Flux themes).
Adds ColorOS 17 fluid wallpapers, with unlock animations that respond to the rhythm of your gestures in real time, making wallpaper switching more natural and device unlocking more immersive.
Adds rotation animations for apps running in landscape mode to make app launch and exit transitions more natural, and improves switching between landscape and portrait modes when a mini window is present on the screen for a more seamless experience.
Refreshes Live Alerts with light, translucent visuals inspired by clouds. Responsive light effects flow naturally with your gestures, while clear, precise tap feedback makes interactions more intuitive and refined.
Adds responsive light effects to Live Alerts for alarms, countdowns, timers, OnePlus Share, and other scenarios, with refined animation details.
Improves music Live Alerts with responsive light effects, including light effects that guide playback progress and diffusing ripple effects when switching songs, making playback feedback more dynamic and immersive while providing a consistent visual experience across the Lock screen and Quick Settings.
Introduces a brand-new design language to system apps, refreshing their look, and improves the designs of the Settings, System & update, About device, and other screens.
Introduces a new system-wide floating-island navigation design for a more immersive app experience, with fluid merging effects when switching between navigation items for more seamless connections between elements.

### Laminar Flow Engine

Upgrades Laminar Flow Engine with a new context-aware scheduling system, optimizing memory management to effectively reduce foreground lag under high memory load and prevent unnecessary background app closures.
Introduces smarter background app management that uses on-device personalized modeling to better understand your intentions and keep the right apps running in the background more intelligently.

### Mind Space

Adds the Travel collection, which automatically organizes your trip locations into a personalized travel map.
Improves memory collections to generate structured image-and-text summaries, making key information easier to browse and understand at a glance.

### Photos

Improves the Memories feature in Photos by using on-device AI models to intelligently understand the relationships between people, events, and time in photos, automatically selecting more story-rich photos and creating personalized memory albums.
You can now view photos and videos from certain third-party devices directly in Photos, and browse and preview them without importing them to your device, making cross-device content viewing more convenient.
You can now select photos and videos directly from certain third-party devices in third-party apps, and share or edit them with a single tap without first saving them locally, making cross-device creation more efficient.

### OSee

Introduces OSee, which integrates the system's AI vision capabilities. Take a photo, and it will intelligently understand your intent and recommend relevant features.
Adds ultra-clear document scanning, enabling you to quickly scan paper documents and generate electronic documents with one tap, making it easier to save and manage your documents. The feature also supports ultra-fast continuous scanning with no waiting between consecutive scans. The all-new AI Hyper Clarity algorithm intelligently optimizes text, edges, and image quality to deliver clearer, sharper document scans.
Supports one-tap, layout-aware document extraction that intelligently preserves headings, paragraphs, tables, and other formatting elements, quickly converting paper documents into editable electronic documents.
Supports scanning and exporting to PDF, as well as merging multiple documents. Merge multiple scanned files with one tap for more efficient document organization.
Supports scanning and one-tap sending to PCs and other devices. After scanning, you can continue editing or sharing, making cross-device work more efficient.
Supports intelligent recognition of various QR code content across system services, third-party apps, and webpages. Scan to pay, add contacts, open services, and more with a single tap.
Integrates the system's Snap & Translate feature. AI intelligently understands text in images and provides accurate translations in a single shot, making it easy to read menus, road signs, manuals, and other foreign-language content.

### AI Translate

Introduces an all-new Translate app with an AI-enhanced translation experience and refreshed interface design. The three core capabilities—photo translation, voice translation, and text translation—are now directly accessible from the bottom navigation, making it easier to switch between them.
Supports more languages for AI model-powered translation (Simplified Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Malay, Vietnamese, Thai, German, French, and Indonesian), delivering more natural translations.
Improves the real-time simultaneous translation experience with faster, smoother responses. Streaming speech recognition and incremental translation work together to achieve ultra-low latency. Large language models use contextual reasoning to accurately handle long sentences, colloquial speech, and professional terms, while voiceprint recognition and speaker separation clearly distinguish between different speakers.
Improves voice translation when using earphones, supporting voice-cloned playback to make communication during travel, business, and multi-person meetings more seamless and efficient.
Improves voice translation when using earphones, making translation faster and more accurate.
You can now triple-tap or pinch supported earbuds to start voice translation without taking out your phone. The bone-conduction sensor works with the multi-microphone array to accurately identify different speakers, making multi-person simultaneous translation more accurate and natural.

### Device Connect

Adds third-party camera support to the O+ Connect ecosystem, enabling seamless connectivity with one-time pairing. Once paired, your camera is automatically detected when powered on and placed near your phone or tablet, and connects with a single tap through Live Alerts, making cross-device connectivity more effortless.

### Other

Adds support for simultaneous audio output from multiple apps, with a toggle switch available in Settings.
In-game screenshots and screen recordings now retain filter effects when game filters are enabled.
Improves the AI network experience by intelligently identifying apps and usage scenarios and dynamically optimizing internet connections and dual-SIM switching strategies for a more stable, smoother online experience under weak network conditions, network congestion, and during gaming.
Improves the screen brightness adjustment algorithm to learn your brightness adjustment habits and automatically adjust screen brightness accordingly.
Improves system sounds and vibration effects in certain scenarios.

Updates for customized devices

This update includes one or more of the following: apps, wallpapers, ringtones, startup animations, Home screen layout, and network settings.

To view more or join a discussion, %s
https://community.oneplus.com

###

2. The installation package will be removed once the installation is complete.

While optimizing, your device might get a little warm, slow down, or use more battery than usual, which is perfectly normal. This is normal, and your device should return to normal in a day or two.

# PJF110_16.0.3.500(CN01)

> OTA 指纹: `PJF110_11.F.13_2130_202601202108 `

- 新增 AI 语音摘记支持更多会议和三方通话类应用，语音记录更方便
- 新增小布记忆账单合集支持通过识别消费行为，为你总结近期消费习惯

## 网络通信
- 新增智慧车载支持无损音质功能，手机媒体音乐可在车端无损播放（仅支持 iccoa 连接方式）
- 新增酷狗概念版支持车载投屏，提升使用体验
- 优化手机连接车辆的流程，操作更简单

## 安全隐私
- 新增支持分享私密保险箱中的文件，分享更便捷
- 新增支持在私密保险箱中通过滑动侧滑条，快速浏览文件
- 新增支持在私密保险箱的文件夹中搜索文件，查找更方便

- 新增自由写支持更多细分场景：写邀请函、申请书等，让工作游刃有余；还可以一键生成多条祝福语、问候语等，让生活从容自在
- 新增 AI 播客功能，将新闻、长文章等通过大模型生成播客，方便在通勤等场景轻松听播客，丰富信息获取方式
- 新增在小布建议和流体云上，显示哈啰单车的履约服务，方便获取信息
- 新增支持通过智能侧边栏快速调出清理存储小工具，清理更方便快捷

## 处处有细节，细节有惊喜

- 新增将应用图标调大并添加常用快捷功能图标后，支持拖拽快捷功能图标进行排序，提升使用效率
- 新增支持在桌面添加 4x2 尺寸的“我的车辆”卡片，还可将卡片自由拖拽为 4x4 尺寸，更美观

- 新增日历的“显示国际节日”开关，开启可显示国际节日，关闭仅显示中国法定节日和传统节日
- 新增支持拖拽调整分身应用图标的大小，并支持添加应用快捷方式，更实用
- 新增桌面 2x1 卡片支持堆叠，提升桌面空间利用率
- 更新 Android 安全补丁至 2025 年 12 月，提升系统安全性
- 优化驾驶模式交互体验，在驾驶模式界面新增退出按钮，操作更快捷
- 优化相册的缩略图解析方式，提升系统相册的缩略图显示速度

## 安全隐私
- 新增在进入手机管家后会弹窗提醒是否允许在 WLAN 和移动数据下自动更新拦截名单，允许后可以及时更新，有效提升检测成功率和防护效率
- 新增支持在私密保险箱中编辑图片和视频，无需将其解除私密即可进行编辑，使用更安心
- 优化手机管家中非首次的病毒扫描速度，减少部分重复计算工作，提升使用体验

### Fluid design. Smooth in motion, vivid by nature.

Introduces an all-new fluid design, crafted for seamless interactions. Smooth in motion, vivid by nature. With seamlessly integrated state transitions, gentle motion rhythms, and lively feedback, the fluid design makes every interaction feel natural.
Adds responsive light effects that balance readability, transparency, and visual aesthetics in a lightweight, friendly, rounded design.
Adds fluid animations. Screen and element transitions now feature fluid merging effects, creating seamless connections between elements and more natural transitions between states.
Adds a flexible feedback system that enables interface elements to naturally stretch, compress under pressure, and rebound dynamically in response to user interactions, while light effects actively respond to user intent and interface changes to convey status, feedback, and guidance through light, making every interaction feel more responsive and creating a more natural, vivid experience.
Introduces the next-generation Luminous Rendering Engine with a new fused rendering architecture that renders light effects and the user interface together, delivering greater rendering efficiency and more refined, seamless fluid animations and visuals.
Adds a fluid clock effect that seamlessly carries the clock across the Always-On Display, Lock screen, and Home screen, creating a natural, cohesive unlocking experience.
Improves the Lock screen swipe-up unlock animation. App icons now animate into view with the fluid clock as a visual anchor, creating a seamless transition from the Lock screen to the Home screen.
Adds a downward collapse effect for Lock screen notifications, allowing notification cards to stack naturally, and improves the progressive transitions and swipe-rebound animations for notification display changes.
Adds responsive behavior to the Lock screen clock font, dynamically adjusting its size based on notification content while ensuring readability at the minimum size.
Improves the visuals and animations of Lock screen widgets, bottom shortcuts, and Live Space capsules, with a new flexible feedback system applied to these elements.
Improves the Lock screen password keypad visuals by optimizing the progressive entry animation and introducing a flexible feedback system for more responsive interactions.
Introduces a new Quick Settings design with responsive light effects for tap interactions, providing more vivid feedback, and improves the visuals and animations on certain secondary pages.
Redesigns the notification drawer with a lighter, more translucent card design, enhancing information contrast and readability. Adds responsive light effects for tap interactions, making the feedback more vivid.
Improves the transition animation between the notification drawer and Quick Settings by introducing a sequential motion effect and dynamically adjusting element movement based on gesture focus and swipe speed, making transitions more responsive, natural, and fluid.
The Sublime Grandeur theme wallpapers now display real-time local weather, so you can check the latest weather information directly from the Home screen and Lock screen.
Adds Lock screen style switching for Flux themes, allowing you to freely switch between clock, graphic-and-text, and photo frame styles to easily create a personalized Lock screen (available for select Flux themes).
Adds ColorOS 17 fluid wallpapers, with unlock animations that respond to the rhythm of your gestures in real time, making wallpaper switching more natural and device unlocking more immersive.
Adds rotation animations for apps running in landscape mode to make app launch and exit transitions more natural, and improves switching between landscape and portrait modes when a mini window is present on the screen for a more seamless experience.
Refreshes Live Alerts with light, translucent visuals inspired by clouds. Responsive light effects flow naturally with your gestures, while clear, precise tap feedback makes interactions more intuitive and refined.
Adds responsive light effects to Live Alerts for alarms, countdowns, timers, OnePlus Share, and other scenarios, with refined animation details.
Improves music Live Alerts with responsive light effects, including light effects that guide playback progress and diffusing ripple effects when switching songs, making playback feedback more dynamic and immersive while providing a consistent visual experience across the Lock screen and Quick Settings.
Introduces a brand-new design language to system apps, refreshing their look, and improves the designs of the Settings, System & update, About device, and other screens.
Introduces a new system-wide floating-island navigation design for a more immersive app experience, with fluid merging effects when switching between navigation items for more seamless connections between elements.

### Laminar Flow Engine

Upgrades Laminar Flow Engine with a new context-aware scheduling system, optimizing memory management to effectively reduce foreground lag under high memory load and prevent unnecessary background app closures.
Introduces smarter background app management that uses on-device personalized modeling to better understand your intentions and keep the right apps running in the background more intelligently.

### Mind Space

Adds the Travel collection, which automatically organizes your trip locations into a personalized travel map.
Improves memory collections to generate structured image-and-text summaries, making key information easier to browse and understand at a glance.

### Photos

Improves the Memories feature in Photos by using on-device AI models to intelligently understand the relationships between people, events, and time in photos, automatically selecting more story-rich photos and creating personalized memory albums.
You can now view photos and videos from certain third-party devices directly in Photos, and browse and preview them without importing them to your device, making cross-device content viewing more convenient.
You can now select photos and videos directly from certain third-party devices in third-party apps, and share or edit them with a single tap without first saving them locally, making cross-device creation more efficient.

### OSee

Introduces OSee, which integrates the system's AI vision capabilities. Take a photo, and it will intelligently understand your intent and recommend relevant features.
Adds ultra-clear document scanning, enabling you to quickly scan paper documents and generate electronic documents with one tap, making it easier to save and manage your documents. The feature also supports ultra-fast continuous scanning with no waiting between consecutive scans. The all-new AI Hyper Clarity algorithm intelligently optimizes text, edges, and image quality to deliver clearer, sharper document scans.
Supports one-tap, layout-aware document extraction that intelligently preserves headings, paragraphs, tables, and other formatting elements, quickly converting paper documents into editable electronic documents.
Supports scanning and exporting to PDF, as well as merging multiple documents. Merge multiple scanned files with one tap for more efficient document organization.
Supports scanning and one-tap sending to PCs and other devices. After scanning, you can continue editing or sharing, making cross-device work more efficient.
Supports intelligent recognition of various QR code content across system services, third-party apps, and webpages. Scan to pay, add contacts, open services, and more with a single tap.
Integrates the system's Snap & Translate feature. AI intelligently understands text in images and provides accurate translations in a single shot, making it easy to read menus, road signs, manuals, and other foreign-language content.

### AI Translate

Introduces an all-new Translate app with an AI-enhanced translation experience and refreshed interface design. The three core capabilities—photo translation, voice translation, and text translation—are now directly accessible from the bottom navigation, making it easier to switch between them.
Supports more languages for AI model-powered translation (Simplified Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Malay, Vietnamese, Thai, German, French, and Indonesian), delivering more natural translations.
Improves the real-time simultaneous translation experience with faster, smoother responses. Streaming speech recognition and incremental translation work together to achieve ultra-low latency. Large language models use contextual reasoning to accurately handle long sentences, colloquial speech, and professional terms, while voiceprint recognition and speaker separation clearly distinguish between different speakers.
Improves voice translation when using earphones, supporting voice-cloned playback to make communication during travel, business, and multi-person meetings more seamless and efficient.
Improves voice translation when using earphones, making translation faster and more accurate.

- 新增主动提醒，系统将感知你的行程节点，主动呈现乘车码、预计进站时间、实时站点信息、换乘提醒、到站下车提醒、出口信息等出行服务，让重要信息始终恰到好处
- 新增城市地标设计，途经部分城市地标时，流体云将呈现专属动态效果，让导航过程更具沉浸感，为每一段旅程增添更多惊喜
- 新增融合导航信息在锁屏岛实时呈现，无需解锁即可查看导航进度与关键信息
- 新增蜂群融合感知技术，通过与三方合作，融合多源环境感知、群体行为建模与端侧个性化学习能力，精准感知你所处环境与行程阶段，实现更精准、更主动、更个性化的智能服务

## 相册
- 新增 AI 修图师，通过自然语言描述修图想法，从光影、构图、色彩、人像等多维度协同优化，呈现更真实自然的修图效果
- 新增 AI 灵感模板推荐，智能理解照片内容与画面风格，主动推荐合适的创作模板，在 AI 修图师与相册创作页均可使用
- 新增 AI 参考图复刻，融合画面语义理解、风格特征提取与美学迁移能力，精准学习参考图风格，实现色彩、光影与美颜效果的自然迁移
- 新增达芬奇视觉理解大模型，融合画面语义理解、美学认知、风格特征学习与生成式优化能力，提供统一算法，实现真实、自然、富有美感的画面效果
- 优化相册回忆能力，通过端侧大模型智能理解照片中的人物、事件与时间关联，自动筛选更具故事性的照片，生成专属回忆影集
- 新增支持在相册中直接查看部分三方设备中的照片和视频，无需导入本地即可浏览、预览，所见即所得，跨设备内容查看更加便捷
- 新增支持三方应用中直接跨端选取部分三方设备中的照片和视频，无需保存至本地即可一键分享或编辑，跨设备创作更加高效

## AI 笔记
- 新增 AI 笔记应用，打造 AI 时代的知识笔记。不止帮你记录信息，更能理解、整理并连接知识，让每一次记录持续沉淀，逐步构建属于你的个人知识体系
- 新增会议笔记，支持会议录音实时转写，支持边听、边记、边拍等多模态会议记录，自动提取会议主题、核心观点、待办事项及责任人，一键生成结构化会议笔记
- 新增说想法功能，支持自然口述记录，AI 会保留原意，清理重复、停顿和口语表达，整理成更清楚的笔记，帮你快速保存灵感、想法与工作内容
- 新增支持导入文档、链接、图片等多种内容，AI 自动识别关键信息，提炼重点并生成结构化笔记。还能与已有知识建立关联，让外部资料逐步转化为可持续积累的个人知识资产
- 新增 AI 笔记助手，可基于笔记内容延展思考、关联历史记录，生成结构化笔记，也能围绕已有内容进行 AI 问答与创作，让零散信息逐步沉淀为知识

## AI 拍一拍
- 全新 AI 拍一拍，整合系统 AI 视觉能力，镜头一拍即可智能识别意图并推荐功能，一看即懂，一按即问，一步直达
- 新增超清文档扫描，支持快速扫描纸质文档，一键生成电子文档，记录资料更加便捷。支持极速连续扫描，连续拍摄无需等待；全新超清增强算法，智能优化文字、边缘与画质，还原更加清晰锐利的文档效果
- 支持文档版式感知提取，一键提取文档内容，智能保留标题、段落、表格等版式信息，让纸质文档快速转换为可编辑电子文档
- 支持扫描导出为常用办公文档格式，并支持多文档装订，一键合并多份扫描文件，文档整理更加高效
- 支持扫描一键发送至电脑等设备，扫描完成即可继续编辑或分享，跨设备办公更加高效
- 支持智能理解各类二维码内容，全面覆盖系统服务、第三方应用及网页场景，扫码支付、添加联系人、打开服务等操作一键即可完成
- 支持扫码快速连接 WLAN，更支持 AI 智能理解图片中的联网信息，即使 WLAN 名称与密码以文字形式展示，也能自动识别并完成连接
- 新增 AI 识万物，智能理解画面中的各类内容，一拍商品即可比价搜同款，一拍食物分析热量、营养及过敏信息，一拍护肤品展示功效并提供使用建议，让生活所见随拍随懂
- 整合系统拍照翻译，AI 智能理解图片中的文字内容，一拍即可完成精准翻译，轻松看懂菜单、路牌、说明书等外文信息
- 新增支持将手机快捷键设置为 AI 拍一拍（仅支持配备快捷键的机型），一键快速开启

## AI 翻译
- 全新翻译应用，AI 重塑翻译体验，焕新界面设计，拍照翻译、语音翻译、文本翻译三大核心能力直达底部导航，切换更加便捷
- 支持更多大模型翻译语言（简体中文、英语、日语、韩语、马来语、越南语、泰语、德语、法语、印尼语），翻译结果更地道
- 优化同传翻译体验，翻译响应更快更流畅，流式语音识别与增量翻译协同实现超低延时同传翻译；大模型结合上下文推理，准确处理长句、口语及专业术语；声纹识别与说话人分离技术，清晰区分不同发言角色
- 优化耳机佩戴场景的语音翻译体验，支持声纹复刻播报，让旅行、商务及多人会议沟通更连贯、更高效
- 优化耳机佩戴场景的语音翻译体验，边听边译更快、更准。进一步提升翻译速度与准确度
- 在部分硬件支持的耳机上，新增连续三次敲击耳机或按捏耳机即可开启语音翻译，无需掏出手机；骨传导传感器与多麦克风矩阵协同，精准识别不同发言人，让多人同传更准确、更自然

## 设备互联
- 新增第三方相机接入 OPPO 互联生态，支持无感互联，仅需一次配对，相机开机靠近手机/平板即可自动发现，并通过流体云一键连接，设备互联更加便捷
- 新增 OPPO 互联-跨设备内容创作，支持在相册中直接查看外接设备中的照片和视频，同时支持第三方应用中直接选取外接设备中的照片和视频，无需导入或保存至本地即可预览、分享、编辑，跨设备创作更加高效

## 安全守护
- 新增 AI 换脸检测功能，实时检测视频通话中的 AI 换脸痕迹，有风险时及时提醒
- 优化 AI 通话防诈识别，结合 AI 合成语音识别与通话语义理解能力，实时检测通话风险，并在发现风险时及时提醒，通话更加安心

## 无障碍模式
- 新增 AI 实景对话无障碍模式（需开启系统 TalkBack 或第三方读屏软件），为视障用户提供更贴心的实景交互体验。针对无障碍场景优化大模型能力，基于真实场景进行更准确、更可信的客观内容描述，帮助用户更轻松地了解身边世界
- 新增 TalkBack 智能读屏功能（设置-辅助功能-无障碍-TalkBack-智能读屏），浏览应用界面时，即使第三方应用未提供无障碍功能，系统也可智能识别按钮、图片、图标等页面内容并进行语音播报，让读屏体验更加完整准确，帮助视障用户更轻松地使用更多应用

## 其他

# CPH2691_17.0.0.105(EX01)

> 官方更新日志 · 来源: 官方 changelog 页面
> OTA 指纹: `CPH2691_11.H.31_3310_202610211518`

### Fluid design. Smooth in motion, vivid by nature.

Introduces an all-new fluid design, crafted for seamless interactions. Smooth in motion, vivid by nature. With seamlessly integrated state transitions, gentle motion rhythms, and lively feedback, the fluid design makes every interaction feel natural.
Adds responsive light effects that balance readability, transparency, and visual aesthetics in a lightweight, friendly, rounded design.
Adds fluid animations. Screen and element transitions now feature fluid merging effects, creating seamless connections between elements and more natural transitions between states.
Adds a flexible feedback system that enables interface elements to naturally stretch, compress under pressure, and rebound dynamically in response to user interactions, while light effects actively respond to user intent and interface changes to convey status, feedback, and guidance through light, making every interaction feel more responsive and creating a more natural, vivid experience.
Introduces the next-generation Luminous Rendering Engine with a new fused rendering architecture that renders light effects and the user interface together, delivering greater rendering efficiency and more refined, seamless fluid animations and visuals.
Adds a fluid clock effect that seamlessly carries the clock across the Always-On Display, Lock screen, and Home screen, creating a natural, cohesive unlocking experience.
Improves the Lock screen swipe-up unlock animation. App icons now animate into view with the fluid clock as a visual anchor, creating a seamless transition from the Lock screen to the Home screen.
Adds a downward collapse effect for Lock screen notifications, allowing notification cards to stack naturally, and improves the progressive transitions and swipe-rebound animations for notification display changes.
Adds responsive behavior to the Lock screen clock font, dynamically adjusting its size based on notification content while ensuring readability at the minimum size.
Improves the visuals and animations of Lock screen widgets, bottom shortcuts, and Live Space capsules, with a new flexible feedback system applied to these elements.
Improves the Lock screen password keypad visuals by optimizing the progressive entry animation and introducing a flexible feedback system for more responsive interactions.
Introduces a new Quick Settings design with responsive light effects for tap interactions, providing more vivid feedback, and improves the visuals and animations on certain secondary pages.
Redesigns the notification drawer with a lighter, more translucent card design, enhancing information contrast and readability. Adds responsive light effects for tap interactions, making the feedback more vivid.
Improves the transition animation between the notification drawer and Quick Settings by introducing a sequential motion effect and dynamically adjusting element movement based on gesture focus and swipe speed, making transitions more responsive, natural, and fluid.
The Sublime Grandeur theme wallpapers now display real-time local weather, so you can check the latest weather information directly from the Home screen and Lock screen.
Adds Lock screen style switching for Flux themes, allowing you to freely switch between clock, graphic-and-text, and photo frame styles to easily create a personalized Lock screen (available for select Flux themes).
Adds ColorOS 17 fluid wallpapers, with unlock animations that respond to the rhythm of your gestures in real time, making wallpaper switching more natural and device unlocking more immersive.
Adds rotation animations for apps running in landscape mode to make app launch and exit transitions more natural, and improves switching between landscape and portrait modes when a mini window is present on the screen for a more seamless experience.
Refreshes Live Alerts with light, translucent visuals inspired by clouds. Responsive light effects flow naturally with your gestures, while clear, precise tap feedback makes interactions more intuitive and refined.
Adds responsive light effects to Live Alerts for alarms, countdowns, timers, OnePlus Share, and other scenarios, with refined animation details.
Improves music Live Alerts with responsive light effects, including light effects that guide playback progress and diffusing ripple effects when switching songs, making playback feedback more dynamic and immersive while providing a consistent visual experience across the Lock screen and Quick Settings.
Introduces a brand-new design language to system apps, refreshing their look, and improves the designs of the Settings, System & update, About device, and other screens.
Introduces a new system-wide floating-island navigation design for a more immersive app experience, with fluid merging effects when switching between navigation items for more seamless connections between elements.

### Laminar Flow Engine

Upgrades Laminar Flow Engine with a new context-aware scheduling system, optimizing memory management to effectively reduce foreground lag under high memory load and prevent unnecessary background app closures.
Introduces smarter background app management that uses on-device personalized modeling to better understand your intentions and keep the right apps running in the background more intelligently.

### Mind Space

Adds the Travel collection, which automatically organizes your trip locations into a personalized travel map.
Improves memory collections to generate structured image-and-text summaries, making key information easier to browse and understand at a glance.

### Photos

Improves the Memories feature in Photos by using on-device AI models to intelligently understand the relationships between people, events, and time in photos, automatically selecting more story-rich photos and creating personalized memory albums.
You can now view photos and videos from certain third-party devices directly in Photos, and browse and preview them without importing them to your device, making cross-device content viewing more convenient.
You can now select photos and videos directly from certain third-party devices in third-party apps, and share or edit them with a single tap without first saving them locally, making cross-device creation more efficient.

### OSee

Introduces OSee, which integrates the system's AI vision capabilities. Take a photo, and it will intelligently understand your intent and recommend relevant features.
Adds ultra-clear document scanning, enabling you to quickly scan paper documents and generate electronic documents with one tap, making it easier to save and manage your documents. The feature also supports ultra-fast continuous scanning with no waiting between consecutive scans. The all-new AI Hyper Clarity algorithm intelligently optimizes text, edges, and image quality to deliver clearer, sharper document scans.
Supports one-tap, layout-aware document extraction that intelligently preserves headings, paragraphs, tables, and other formatting elements, quickly converting paper documents into editable electronic documents.
Supports scanning and exporting to PDF, as well as merging multiple documents. Merge multiple scanned files with one tap for more efficient document organization.
Supports scanning and one-tap sending to PCs and other devices. After scanning, you can continue editing or sharing, making cross-device work more efficient.
Supports intelligent recognition of various QR code content across system services, third-party apps, and webpages. Scan to pay, add contacts, open services, and more with a single tap.
Integrates the system's Snap & Translate feature. AI intelligently understands text in images and provides accurate translations in a single shot, making it easy to read menus, road signs, manuals, and other foreign-language content.

### AI Translate

Introduces an all-new Translate app with an AI-enhanced translation experience and refreshed interface design. The three core capabilities—photo translation, voice translation, and text translation—are now directly accessible from the bottom navigation, making it easier to switch between them.
Supports more languages for AI model-powered translation (Simplified Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Malay, Vietnamese, Thai, German, French, and Indonesian), delivering more natural translations.
Improves the real-time simultaneous translation experience with faster, smoother responses. Streaming speech recognition and incremental translation work together to achieve ultra-low latency. Large language models use contextual reasoning to accurately handle long sentences, colloquial speech, and professional terms, while voiceprint recognition and speaker separation clearly distinguish between different speakers.
Improves voice translation when using earphones, supporting voice-cloned playback to make communication during travel, business, and multi-person meetings more seamless and efficient.
Improves voice translation when using earphones, making translation faster and more accurate.
You can now triple-tap or pinch supported earbuds to start voice translation without taking out your phone. The bone-conduction sensor works with the multi-microphone array to accurately identify different speakers, making multi-person simultaneous translation more accurate and natural.

### Device Connect

Adds third-party camera support to the O+ Connect ecosystem, enabling seamless connectivity with one-time pairing. Once paired, your camera is automatically detected when powered on and placed near your phone or tablet, and connects with a single tap through Live Alerts, making cross-device connectivity more effortless.

### Other

Adds support for simultaneous audio output from multiple apps, with a toggle switch available in Settings.
Improves the AI network experience by intelligently identifying apps and usage scenarios and dynamically optimizing internet connections and dual-SIM switching strategies for a more stable, smoother online experience under weak network conditions, network congestion, and during gaming.
Improves the screen brightness adjustment algorithm to learn your brightness adjustment habits and automatically adjust screen brightness accordingly.
Improves system sounds and vibration effects in certain scenarios.

### Animations

A cutting-edge system graphics engine is available to deliver superior rendering and animation performance. Its innovative parallel drawing architecture ensures smooth, uninterrupted visuals, even when switching between multiple apps or pushing the system to its limits. Stability and fluidity are guaranteed under any conditions.
Parallel animation covers more elements like widgets, components, and folders, ensuring seamless transitions and smooth animations, even during frequent interruptions.
System-wide swipe consistency is extended to third-party apps, including WebView interfaces, for a uniform scrolling experience across the entire system.

### Visual effects

The Home screen is revamped with newly designed icons, presenting a fresh look with balanced proportions and enhanced colors for fuller and sharper visuals.
Numerous system function icons are overhauled for improved visual uniformity throughout the system.
The rounded corner design is enhanced for uniformity and continuous curvature is applied throughout the system.

### Themes

The new flux themes feature a vast array of high-quality themes, allowing customization with system wallpapers and personal photos for a personalized touch.
Extensive customization is added for Always-On Display, the Lock screen, and the Home screen. Flux and classic modes are supported for Always-On Display. Clock color blending, glass textures, blurred wallpapers, AI depth effects, AI auto-fills, and more are supported for the Lock screen. Glass patterns, blurred wallpapers, and more are supported for the Home screen.
The new flux themes present fluid and seamless transition animations among Always-On Display, Lock screen, and Home screen for improved visual consistency.

### Live Alerts

The new Live Alerts design is concentrated on efficient information visualization, positioned centrally for a balanced and streamlined display.
The new Live Alerts interaction allows capsules to expand into detailed cards with a tap, providing efficient access to multiple live activities by swiping in the status bar.
The new Live Alerts animation system brings a fluid, elastic design and dynamic blurring effects in real time, making card visuals smoother and more refined.

### Photo editing

The new globally reversible photo editing capability saves previous edit settings for seamless subsequent edits, ensuring uninterrupted creative flow.

### Floating Window and Split View

The new Floating Window gestures: you can swipe down a notification banner to open a floating window, swipe down to enlarge it, swipe up to close it, and swipe sideways to hide it.
The resizable Split View windows allow you to drag the divider or tap the window for a more extensive display area.

### Notifications & Quick Settings

The new Split mode allows separate access to the notification drawer (top-left swipe) and Quick Settings (top-right swipe), with swipe left or right to switch.
Quick Settings is revamped with a more visually appealing and consistent layout, along with refined and enhanced animations.

### Battery & charging

The new ""Charging limit"" feature halts charging at 80%, helping to extend battery life and minimize degradation.
The new battery protection reminder activates the Charging limit feature if the device remains charging for too long, enhancing battery protection.

### Sounds & vibration

Holo Audio is enhanced for internet calls and meetings, providing a more comprehensive and immersive sound quality.

### More

Exclusive OxygenOS Always-On Displays and Lock screen clock styles are added for a unique visual experience.
The new Home screen clock widget gives you the flexibility to resize as desired.
An easter egg is added in Calculator and will pop up when you input ""1+="", embodying OnePlus's enduring ""Never Settle"" mentality.
New wallpapers are added to infuse your device with OnePlus's signature style.
Exclusive app icon designs for OxygenOS are added, offering a fresh visual experience.
The Two-Tone theme color is added, enabling Quick Settings and the Settings app icon to be displayed in ""Black"" to highlight OxygenOS's iconic design.
The style and visuals of the Notes widgets are enhanced, making them more appealing and practical.
The multitasking experience is enhanced by automatically guiding you to the last used app in the recent tasks view for easier app switching.
The Drawer mode is optimized to keep the existing Home screen app layout upon initial entry.

### Safety

A unified hub for personal safety features brings together emergency calls, disaster alerts, security checks, and quick access to first aid information.

### Privacy

The Private Safe is optimized by implementing categorized views for images, videos, and documents, simplifying data management.
A new Home screen entry is added for hidden apps, allowing quick access by tapping the folder and verifying your privacy password.

### Wi-Fi

The multi-network experience is enhanced to deliver more efficient, accurate, and uninterrupted transitions between networks

- 新增长按桌面大文件夹，可以选择更多风格样式，如 9 宫格视图、4 宫格视图、凸显首应用大图标

# PJA110_16.0.2.400(CN01)

> 官方更新日志 · 来源: OTA descriptionInfo
> OTA 指纹: `PJA110_11.H.09_3090_202512162156 `

## 极光引擎
- 极光引擎再进化，全面升级系统视觉动效，带来无缝的操控感，界面秩序感和视觉爽快感。从哪里来，回哪里去，处处丝滑流畅
- 新增桌面图标、卡片、文件夹、侧边栏等场景支持无缝拖拽动画，提供一气呵成的直觉操作体验
- 新增系统文本选择放大镜的出现、消失支持无缝过渡动效
- 新增系统 UI 控件支持无缝过渡动效，如信息、电话本等的新建按钮
- 新增在打开通知中心、控制中心时，状态栏支持无缝切换动画，下拉过程可实时打断操作，画面更流畅
- 新增在控制中心点击音频播放卡片时，支持无缝切换动画，视觉更美观
- 新增侧滑跟手动画，在部分应用中当你侧滑返回时可以预览上一页的内容，并支持阻断操作，画面更跟手更自然
- 新增在使用虚拟按键导航方式时，支持桌面应用启动、退出并行动画，让操作画面更丝滑连贯
- 新增在计算器、锁屏密码、通话界面等按压交互时，呈现更沉浸更生动的光场动效
- 新增在 AI 场景（如小布助手、小布记忆、小布识屏、AI 图像编辑等）下的光场动效效果，更具智慧感与氛围感
- 优化桌面上排应用图标退出动画曲线，操作更有掌控感
- 优化系统列表滑动动画曲线与阻尼，滑动效果更跟手，更丝滑

## 潮汐引擎
- 潮汐引擎带来更全面的流畅体验。通过动态适配场景资源需求、智能调节运行负载，带来短视频久刷不卡顿、游戏重载不掉帧、影像久拍不中断的持久流畅体验
- 重构内存管理方案，优化短视频连续滑动过程中的后台管理策略。匹配短视频观看习惯，自动调整缓存释放策略，实现久刷也流畅，观影更畅快
- 智能分析游戏过程中的关键计算任务，优先保障游戏的稳定调度。精细化管理游戏中常用的应用小窗、视频通话等并发任务，智能调度，不仅节省功耗，还能稳定流畅
- 优化闪电启动功能，提升部分游戏的启动速度
- 优化应用启动响应速度，在桌面启动应用，反应更迅速
- 新增更多应用支持视频长续航功能，续航更持久
- 新增支持智能温控联动，当设备温度过高时，将自动进入视频长续航模式，有效平衡性能与功耗
- 新增长续航场景智能识别功能，在高铁、地铁等特定出行场景下，自动进入视频长续航模式，让旅途用机更持久
- 优化开启省电模式后的管理策略，在不同电量下提供阶梯化性能管理策略，带来更持久和更流畅的使用体验

## 繁星编译器
- 新增繁星编译器，通过业界独创的跨层级融合优化、反馈式优化等编译器优化技术，大幅提升了编译语言的执行效率，助力系统响应更迅速更流畅
- 优化系统服务代码的执行效率，提升开机速度，降低服务能耗
- 通过更精准地预优化系统公共库，使程序运行时功耗更低，更省内存
- 通过更准确更细致的反馈式优化，降低 IO 损耗，提升应用程序启动速度
- 提升 UI 相关代码的编译优化质量，使应用响应更快，帧率更稳

## 小布助手
- 新增桌面小布超级入口，并全面整合打通小布记忆，系统 AI 一站搞定
- 小布助手全面焕新，视觉与交互重构，全新唤醒页环绕式光场设计，大幅简化交互界面，更沉浸更生动
- 优化连续对话功能，对话过程中可以随时打断
- 新增支持将小布对话保存到小布记忆
- 新增 AI 实景对话功能，逛展逛街逛世界，生活百科、点评探店，一问即知
- 新增 AI 实景对话指哪答哪，点击屏幕上好奇的事物，小布能即时为你解答
- 新增 AI 实景对话专属声纹识别，小布可以记住你的声纹信息，环境再吵只听你讲

## 小布记忆
- 优化小布记忆详情页，AI 摘要更详尽，内容识别更精准。并支持添加备注，突出提取重点信息，一眼明确要点
- 新增记忆搜索，小布记忆与系统打通，支持在全局搜索或小布助手中，搜索小布记忆里的内容，还能将搜到的内容进行整理、分析和归纳总结
- 新增记多图、记文档、记截图，还能通过 AI 分析并保存到小布记忆中。拓展小布记忆支持记录的内容类型，更全面更高效
- 新增视频记，视频懒得看，小布记忆帮你看。在部分应用内观看视频时一键闪记，快速将视频记录下来并自动分段摘要及重点高光提取，部分应用还支持跳转高光时间点，方便回看
- 新增 AI 取餐码，点单时在取餐码界面一键闪记，即可识别取餐信息并推送到流体云上显示，部分品牌支持自动上云，此刻记下，码上用上，随时查看超方便。
- 新增记账单，在支付界面一键闪记，会自动识别账单并记录到小布记忆中，并自动沉淀账单合集，此刻记下，月月清晰
- 新增在截屏缩略图上支持一键闪记，快速将截图内容记录下来
- 新增自动收藏，支持收藏小红书、微博、抖音、知乎、今日头条新闻、豆瓣帖子等内容，自动同步到小布记忆中，记录更简单，查找更便捷
- 新增支持手机在横屏状态时，可以触发一键闪记，记下横屏内容
- 新增手表连接手机后，可以在手表端唤醒小布助手并输入内容，内容将保存至手机端的小布记忆中；也可以直接在手表端使用小布助手搜索手机端小布记忆中的内容

## 小布建议
- 小布建议服务内容大幅扩展，涵盖通勤出行（如航班、高铁、打车、酒店行程等）、生活服务（信用卡还款、生活缴费提醒、快递提醒、外卖与就餐服务、电影演出提醒等）、办公学习（日程提醒、课程提醒等）、内容服务（订阅的篮球、足球、电竞提醒等），覆盖生活方方面面
- 新增打通小布记忆，根据使用场景主动推荐小布记忆中收藏的美食店铺、电影票、酒店订单、景点门票等
- 新增小布建议晨间 AI 简报功能，动态感知和整理你的重要信息，如天气、日程、AI 资讯，帮你快速一览当天重要事项

## 小布识屏
- 新增端云识别框架，大幅提升图文识别准确率
- 新增小布识屏支持圈选，并打通小布助手，圈选后支持向小布提问

- 新增与电脑的剪贴板同步功能，复制的文本可跨端粘贴，跨端操作更方便

- 新增网络检测功能，可对当前网络进行测速，查看网络状态，如：网络延迟、上传/下载速度等

- 全新通知样式，空间占用更小，浏览效率更高

## 自由窗口
- 新增自由浮窗窗口控制器可选择分屏，点击即可将应用由浮窗变为分屏显示

- 新增支持将本地视频设为电话铃声，让你的铃声更具个性化

## 流体设计，流动丝滑，鲜活自然
- 全新流体设计，为流畅而生的设计语言，流动丝滑，鲜活自然。流体设计以融合一体的状态衔接、柔和的动态节奏和鲜活的反馈体验，让每一次交互都自然发生
- 新增凝光视效，通过轻盈、亲和、圆润的材质设计，兼顾界面的可读性、通透性与视觉美观性
- 新增流体动效，界面与元素过渡支持流体融合效果，让元素无缝衔接、状态自然流转
- 新增柔性反馈系统，全局元素随操作自然拉伸、受力挤压、灵动回弹，光效随着意图与界面变化主动响应，以光传递状态、反馈与引导，让每一次操作都响应交互意图，更自然、更鲜活
- 全新一代极光引擎，新增融合渲染架构，光效与界面融合渲染，带来更高效的渲染性能，呈现更细腻连贯的流体动画与视觉效果
- 新增流体时钟效果，息屏、锁屏、桌面时钟无缝共享，如同天生一体，带来自然连贯的解锁体验
- 优化锁屏上滑解锁动效，以流体时钟为视觉锚点，图标以此为中心动态响应进场动效，让视觉焦点保持连续，实现从锁屏到桌面的动效一体性
- 新增锁屏通知下沉效果，卡片自然堆叠，优化通知状态切换递进效果和滑动回弹动效
- 新增锁屏时钟字体的响应效果，根据通知内容自适应尺寸显示，并保障时钟字体在最小尺寸时的可读性
- 优化锁屏小组件、锁屏底部快捷方式、锁屏岛胶囊的视觉、动画效果以及引入柔性反馈系统
- 优化锁屏密码盘视觉效果，优化出场递进动画，以及引入柔性反馈系统，提升交互响应速度
- 全新控制中心设计，新增按压凝光视效，按压反馈更生动；优化部分二级页面视觉与动画效果
- 全新通知中心设计，更轻盈通透的卡片材质，提升信息对比与可读性。新增按压凝光视效，按压反馈更生动
- 优化通知中心与控制中心切换动画效果，引入渐进式运动时差，并根据手势焦点与滑动速率动态调整元素运动，让切换更跟手、更自然，也更具流动感
- 新增山之道-实况天气，山之道主题支持实时显示当前天气，在桌面和锁屏沉浸式感受朝晴暮雨的自然变化
- 新增灵感主题-锁屏样式切换功能，支持在时钟、图文、相框样式间自由切换，轻松打造个性化锁屏界面（部分灵感主题支持）
- 新增 ColorOS 17 流体壁纸，解锁动画实时响应手势节奏，让壁纸流转更加自然，解锁更具沉浸感
- 流体云全面焕新，视觉如云般轻盈通透。凝光随手势自然流动，按压反馈清晰明确，让交互更直观、更有质感
- 新增闹钟、倒计时、计时器、OPPO 互传、来电等场景的流体云凝光视效，优化细节动效
- 优化音乐流体云卡片，引入凝光视效，播放进度凝光指引、切歌光效弥散涟漪，让播放反馈更灵动沉浸，并在锁屏及控制中心一致呈现
- 新增系统应用引入全新设计语言，视觉效果焕然一新，优化设置、系统更新、关于手机等界面设计
- 新增全局浮岛式导航设计，应用界面更加沉浸；导航切换新增流体融合过渡，让元素衔接更加自然

## 潮汐引擎
- 潮汐引擎全面升级，带来全新自研感知调度，优化系统内存调度策略，高内存负载下有效减少前台卡顿，降低后台应用误清理
- 新增记忆后台，通过端侧个人化建模，更懂你的意图，实现更精准、更智能的应用保活
- 新增应用小程序加速器，提升启动与运行效率，提升加载速度；多小程序并行运行时，动态调配系统资源，保障运行更加流畅

## 你的小布
- 新增全新小布唤醒动画，以拟人化形象自然回应，并加入语音文字动效，让交互更聚焦、更自然
- 优化小布连续对话体验，提升多轮对话中的上下文理解能力，更好理解前后信息，让连续交流更自然
- 升级小布意图理解能力，更准确识别问答与用机需求，提供更精准的回答和操作服务
- 升级旅行规划能力，结合小布记忆生成更懂你的结构化旅行攻略，并接入腾讯地图服务，让行程规划更个性、更便捷
- 新增一句话整理相册，支持通过自然语言快速找出想要的照片并创建图集，让照片整理更简单高效
- 新增小布与我，小布自动学习你的长期偏好，越来越懂你；同时支持自定义小布的人格风格，打造专属于你的小布
- 新增更多一键闪记场景，智能识别应用中联系人信息，联系人可一键添加，抢购/抢票界面闪记可一键创建秒抢闹钟，让信息快速转化为服务
- 新增一键闪记意图推荐，一键闪记后基于屏幕内容智能理解更多意图，推荐更多相关服务，一步直达所需

## AI 流体云
- 新增流体云融合导航，支持在流体云智能分阶段呈现步行、打车、地铁、公交导航信息，全程无缝接续（该功能支持百度地图、高德地图）
- 新增主动提醒，系统将感知你的行程节点，主动呈现乘车码、预计进站时间、实时站点信息、换乘提醒、到站下车提醒、出口信息等出行服务，让重要信息始终恰到好处
- 新增城市地标设计，途经部分城市地标时，流体云将呈现专属动态效果，让导航过程更具沉浸感，为每一段旅程增添更多惊喜
- 新增融合导航信息在锁屏岛实时呈现，无需解锁即可查看导航进度与关键信息
- 新增蜂群融合感知技术，通过与三方合作，融合多源环境感知、群体行为建模与端侧个性化学习能力，精准感知你所处环境与行程阶段，实现更精准、更主动、更个性化的智能服务

## 相册
- 新增 AI 修图师，通过自然语言描述修图想法，从光影、构图、色彩、人像等多维度协同优化，呈现更真实自然的修图效果
- 新增 AI 灵感模板推荐，智能理解照片内容与画面风格，主动推荐合适的创作模板，在 AI 修图师与相册创作页均可使用
- 新增 AI 参考图复刻，融合画面语义理解、风格特征提取与美学迁移能力，精准学习参考图风格，实现色彩、光影与美颜效果的自然迁移
- 新增达芬奇视觉理解大模型，融合画面语义理解、美学认知、风格特征学习与生成式优化能力，提供统一算法，实现真实、自然、富有美感的画面效果
- 优化相册回忆能力，通过端侧大模型智能理解照片中的人物、事件与时间关联，自动筛选更具故事性的照片，生成专属回忆影集
- 新增支持在相册中直接查看部分三方设备中的照片和视频，无需导入本地即可浏览、预览，所见即所得，跨设备内容查看更加便捷
- 新增支持三方应用中直接跨端选取部分三方设备中的照片和视频，无需保存至本地即可一键分享或编辑，跨设备创作更加高效

## AI 笔记
- 新增 AI 笔记应用，打造 AI 时代的知识笔记。不止帮你记录信息，更能理解、整理并连接知识，让每一次记录持续沉淀，逐步构建属于你的个人知识体系
- 新增会议笔记，支持会议录音实时转写，支持边听、边记、边拍等多模态会议记录，自动提取会议主题、核心观点、待办事项及责任人，一键生成结构化会议笔记
- 新增说想法功能，支持自然口述记录，AI 会保留原意，清理重复、停顿和口语表达，整理成更清楚的笔记，帮你快速保存灵感、想法与工作内容
- 新增支持导入文档、链接、图片等多种内容，AI 自动识别关键信息，提炼重点并生成结构化笔记。还能与已有知识建立关联，让外部资料逐步转化为可持续积累的个人知识资产
- 新增 AI 笔记助手，可基于笔记内容延展思考、关联历史记录，生成结构化笔记，也能围绕已有内容进行 AI 问答与创作，让零散信息逐步沉淀为知识

## AI 拍一拍
- 全新 AI 拍一拍，整合系统 AI 视觉能力，镜头一拍即可智能识别意图并推荐功能，一看即懂，一按即问，一步直达
- 新增超清文档扫描，支持快速扫描纸质文档，一键生成电子文档，记录资料更加便捷。支持极速连续扫描，连续拍摄无需等待；全新超清增强算法，智能优化文字、边缘与画质，还原更加清晰锐利的文档效果
- 支持文档版式感知提取，一键提取文档内容，智能保留标题、段落、表格等版式信息，让纸质文档快速转换为可编辑电子文档
- 支持扫描导出为常用办公文档格式，并支持多文档装订，一键合并多份扫描文件，文档整理更加高效
- 支持扫描一键发送至电脑等设备，扫描完成即可继续编辑或分享，跨设备办公更加高效
- 支持智能理解各类二维码内容，全面覆盖系统服务、第三方应用及网页场景，扫码支付、添加联系人、打开服务等操作一键即可完成
- 支持扫码快速连接 WLAN，更支持 AI 智能理解图片中的联网信息，即使 WLAN 名称与密码以文字形式展示，也能自动识别并完成连接
- 新增 AI 识万物，智能理解画面中的各类内容，一拍商品即可比价搜同款，一拍食物分析热量、营养及过敏信息，一拍护肤品展示功效并提供使用建议，让生活所见随拍随懂
- 整合系统拍照翻译，AI 智能理解图片中的文字内容，一拍即可完成精准翻译，轻松看懂菜单、路牌、说明书等外文信息

## AI 翻译
- 全新翻译应用，AI 重塑翻译体验，焕新界面设计，拍照翻译、语音翻译、文本翻译三大核心能力直达底部导航，切换更加便捷
- 支持更多大模型翻译语言（简体中文、英语、日语、韩语、马来语、越南语、泰语、德语、法语、印尼语），翻译结果更地道
- 优化同传翻译体验，翻译响应更快更流畅，流式语音识别与增量翻译协同实现超低延时同传翻译；大模型结合上下文推理，准确处理长句、口语及专业术语；声纹识别与说话人分离技术，清晰区分不同发言角色
- 优化耳机佩戴场景的语音翻译体验，支持声纹复刻播报，让旅行、商务及多人会议沟通更连贯、更高效
- 优化耳机佩戴场景的语音翻译体验，边听边译更快、更准。进一步提升翻译速度与准确度
- 在部分硬件支持的耳机上，新增连续三次敲击耳机或按捏耳机即可开启语音翻译，无需掏出手机；骨传导传感器与多麦克风矩阵协同，精准识别不同发言人，让多人同传更准确、更自然

## 设备互联
- 新增第三方相机接入 OPPO 互联生态，支持无感互联，仅需一次配对，相机开机靠近手机/平板即可自动发现，并通过流体云一键连接，设备互联更加便捷
- 新增 OPPO 互联-跨设备内容创作，支持在相册中直接查看外接设备中的照片和视频，同时支持第三方应用中直接选取外接设备中的照片和视频，无需导入或保存至本地即可预览、分享、编辑，跨设备创作更加高效

## 安全守护
- 新增 AI 换脸检测功能，实时检测视频通话中的 AI 换脸痕迹，有风险时及时提醒
- 优化 AI 通话防诈识别，结合 AI 合成语音识别与通话语义理解能力，实时检测通话风险，并在发现风险时及时提醒，通话更加安心

## 无障碍模式
- 新增 AI 实景对话无障碍模式（需开启系统 TalkBack 或第三方读屏软件），为视障用户提供更贴心的实景交互体验。针对无障碍场景优化大模型能力，基于真实场景进行更准确、更可信的客观内容描述，帮助用户更轻松地了解身边世界
- 新增 TalkBack 智能读屏功能（设置-辅助功能-无障碍-TalkBack-智能读屏），浏览应用界面时，即使第三方应用未提供无障碍功能，系统也可智能识别按钮、图片、图标等页面内容并进行语音播报，让读屏体验更加完整准确，帮助视障用户更轻松地使用更多应用

## 其他
- 新增多应用同时输出音频功能，并在设置中提供开关选项
- 优化 AI 网络体验，智能识别不同应用与使用场景，动态优化网络连接与双卡切换策略，在弱网、网络拥堵及游戏等场景下，带来更稳定、更流畅的上网体验
- 优化屏幕亮度调节算法，智能记忆亮度调节使用习惯，并自动适配屏幕亮度
- 优化系统部分场景声音与振动效果

# PKU110_17.0.0.104(CN01)

## 流体设计，流动丝滑，鲜活自然
- 全新流体设计，为流畅而生的设计语言，流动丝滑，鲜活自然。流体设计以融合一体的状态衔接、柔和的动态节奏和鲜活的反馈体验，让每一次交互都自然发生
- 新增凝光视效，通过轻盈、亲和、圆润的材质设计，兼顾界面的可读性、通透性与视觉美观性
- 新增流体动效，界面与元素过渡支持流体融合效果，让元素无缝衔接、状态自然流转
- 新增柔性反馈系统，全局元素随操作自然拉伸、受力挤压、灵动回弹，光效随着意图与界面变化主动响应，以光传递状态、反馈与引导，让每一次操作都响应交互意图，更自然、更鲜活
- 全新一代极光引擎，新增融合渲染架构，光效与界面融合渲染，带来更高效的渲染性能，呈现更细腻连贯的流体动画与视觉效果
- 新增流体时钟效果，息屏、锁屏、桌面时钟无缝共享，如同天生一体，带来自然连贯的解锁体验
- 优化锁屏上滑解锁动效，以流体时钟为视觉锚点，图标以此为中心动态响应进场动效，让视觉焦点保持连续，实现从锁屏到桌面的动效一体性
- 新增锁屏通知下沉效果，卡片自然堆叠，优化通知状态切换递进效果和滑动回弹动效
- 新增锁屏时钟字体的响应效果，根据通知内容自适应尺寸显示，并保障时钟字体在最小尺寸时的可读性
- 优化锁屏小组件、锁屏底部快捷方式、锁屏岛胶囊的视觉、动画效果以及引入柔性反馈系统
- 优化锁屏密码盘视觉效果，优化出场递进动画，以及引入柔性反馈系统，提升交互响应速度
- 全新控制中心设计，新增按压凝光视效，按压反馈更生动；优化部分二级页面视觉与动画效果
- 全新通知中心设计，更轻盈通透的卡片材质，提升信息对比与可读性。新增按压凝光视效，按压反馈更生动
- 优化通知中心与控制中心切换动画效果，引入渐进式运动时差，并根据手势焦点与滑动速率动态调整元素运动，让切换更跟手、更自然，也更具流动感
- 新增山之道-实况天气，山之道主题支持实时显示当前天气，在桌面和锁屏沉浸式感受朝晴暮雨的自然变化
- 新增灵感主题-锁屏样式切换功能，支持在时钟、图文、相框样式间自由切换，轻松打造个性化锁屏界面（部分灵感主题支持）
- 新增 ColorOS 17 流体壁纸，解锁动画实时响应手势节奏，让壁纸流转更加自然，解锁更具沉浸感
- 优化速览界面进入动效，引入渐进式运动时差，让界面过渡更连贯、更具节奏感
- 新增横屏应用旋转动效，应用启动与退出过渡更自然，同时优化在有小窗挂起时的多窗口横竖屏无缝切换效果
- 流体云全面焕新，视觉如云般轻盈通透。凝光随手势自然流动，按压反馈清晰明确，让交互更直观、更有质感
- 新增闹钟、倒计时、计时器、OPPO 互传、来电等场景的流体云凝光视效，优化细节动效
- 优化音乐流体云卡片，引入凝光视效，播放进度凝光指引、切歌光效弥散涟漪，让播放反馈更灵动沉浸，并在锁屏及控制中心一致呈现
- 新增系统应用引入全新设计语言，视觉效果焕然一新，优化设置、系统更新、关于手机等界面设计
- 新增全局浮岛式导航设计，应用界面更加沉浸；导航切换新增流体融合过渡，让元素衔接更加自然

## 潮汐引擎
- 潮汐引擎全面升级，带来全新自研感知调度，优化系统内存调度策略，高内存负载下有效减少前台卡顿，降低后台应用误清理
- 新增记忆后台，通过端侧个人化建模，更懂你的意图，实现更精准、更智能的应用保活
- 新增应用小程序加速器，提升启动与运行效率，提升加载速度；多小程序并行运行时，动态调配系统资源，保障运行更加流畅

## 你的小布
- 新增全新小布唤醒动画，以拟人化形象自然回应，并加入语音文字动效，让交互更聚焦、更自然
- 优化小布连续对话体验，提升多轮对话中的上下文理解能力，更好理解前后信息，让连续交流更自然
- 升级小布意图理解能力，更准确识别问答与用机需求，提供更精准的回答和操作服务
- 升级旅行规划能力，结合小布记忆生成更懂你的结构化旅行攻略，并接入腾讯地图服务，让行程规划更个性、更便捷
- 新增一句话整理相册，支持通过自然语言快速找出想要的照片并创建图集，让照片整理更简单高效
- 新增小布与我，小布自动学习你的长期偏好，越来越懂你；同时支持自定义小布的人格风格，打造专属于你的小布
- 新增更多一键闪记场景，智能识别应用中联系人信息，联系人可一键添加，抢购/抢票界面闪记可一键创建秒抢闹钟，让信息快速转化为服务
- 新增一键闪记意图推荐，一键闪记后基于屏幕内容智能理解更多意图，推荐更多相关服务，一步直达所需

## AI 流体云
- 新增流体云融合导航，支持在流体云智能分阶段呈现步行、打车、地铁、公交导航信息，全程无缝接续（该功能支持百度地图、高德地图）
- 新增主动提醒，系统将感知你的行程节点，主动呈现乘车码、预计进站时间、实时站点信息、换乘提醒、到站下车提醒、出口信息等出行服务，让重要信息始终恰到好处
- 新增城市地标设计，途经部分城市地标时，流体云将呈现专属动态效果，让导航过程更具沉浸感，为每一段旅程增添更多惊喜
- 新增融合导航信息在锁屏岛实时呈现，无需解锁即可查看导航进度与关键信息
- 新增蜂群融合感知技术，通过与三方合作，融合多源环境感知、群体行为建模与端侧个性化学习能力，精准感知你所处环境与行程阶段，实现更精准、更主动、更个性化的智能服务

## 相册
- 新增 AI 修图师，通过自然语言描述修图想法，从光影、构图、色彩、人像等多维度协同优化，呈现更真实自然的修图效果
- 新增 AI 灵感模板推荐，智能理解照片内容与画面风格，主动推荐合适的创作模板，在 AI 修图师与相册创作页均可使用
- 新增 AI 参考图复刻，融合画面语义理解、风格特征提取与美学迁移能力，精准学习参考图风格，实现色彩、光影与美颜效果的自然迁移
- 新增达芬奇视觉理解大模型，融合画面语义理解、美学认知、风格特征学习与生成式优化能力，提供统一算法，实现真实、自然、富有美感的画面效果
- 优化相册回忆能力，通过端侧大模型智能理解照片中的人物、事件与时间关联，自动筛选更具故事性的照片，生成专属回忆影集
- 新增支持在相册中直接查看部分三方设备中的照片和视频，无需导入本地即可浏览、预览，所见即所得，跨设备内容查看更加便捷
- 新增支持三方应用中直接跨端选取部分三方设备中的照片和视频，无需保存至本地即可一键分享或编辑，跨设备创作更加高效

## AI 笔记
- 新增 AI 笔记应用，打造 AI 时代的知识笔记。不止帮你记录信息，更能理解、整理并连接知识，让每一次记录持续沉淀，逐步构建属于你的个人知识体系
- 新增会议笔记，支持会议录音实时转写，支持边听、边记、边拍等多模态会议记录，自动提取会议主题、核心观点、待办事项及责任人，一键生成结构化会议笔记
- 新增说想法功能，支持自然口述记录，AI 会保留原意，清理重复、停顿和口语表达，整理成更清楚的笔记，帮你快速保存灵感、想法与工作内容
- 新增支持导入文档、链接、图片等多种内容，AI 自动识别关键信息，提炼重点并生成结构化笔记。还能与已有知识建立关联，让外部资料逐步转化为可持续积累的个人知识资产
- 新增 AI 笔记助手，可基于笔记内容延展思考、关联历史记录，生成结构化笔记，也能围绕已有内容进行 AI 问答与创作，让零散信息逐步沉淀为知识

## AI 拍一拍
- 全新 AI 拍一拍，整合系统 AI 视觉能力，镜头一拍即可智能识别意图并推荐功能，一看即懂，一按即问，一步直达
- 新增超清文档扫描，支持快速扫描纸质文档，一键生成电子文档，记录资料更加便捷。支持极速连续扫描，连续拍摄无需等待；全新超清增强算法，智能优化文字、边缘与画质，还原更加清晰锐利的文档效果
- 支持文档版式感知提取，一键提取文档内容，智能保留标题、段落、表格等版式信息，让纸质文档快速转换为可编辑电子文档
- 支持扫描导出为常用办公文档格式，并支持多文档装订，一键合并多份扫描文件，文档整理更加高效
- 支持扫描一键发送至电脑等设备，扫描完成即可继续编辑或分享，跨设备办公更加高效
- 支持智能理解各类二维码内容，全面覆盖系统服务、第三方应用及网页场景，扫码支付、添加联系人、打开服务等操作一键即可完成
- 支持扫码快速连接 WLAN，更支持 AI 智能理解图片中的联网信息，即使 WLAN 名称与密码以文字形式展示，也能自动识别并完成连接
- 新增 AI 识万物，智能理解画面中的各类内容，一拍商品即可比价搜同款，一拍食物分析热量、营养及过敏信息，一拍护肤品展示功效并提供使用建议，让生活所见随拍随懂
- 整合系统拍照翻译，AI 智能理解图片中的文字内容，一拍即可完成精准翻译，轻松看懂菜单、路牌、说明书等外文信息
- 新增支持将手机快捷键设置为 AI 拍一拍（仅支持配备快捷键的机型），一键快速开启

## AI 翻译
- 全新翻译应用，AI 重塑翻译体验，焕新界面设计，拍照翻译、语音翻译、文本翻译三大核心能力直达底部导航，切换更加便捷
- 支持更多大模型翻译语言（简体中文、英语、日语、韩语、马来语、越南语、泰语、德语、法语、印尼语），翻译结果更地道
- 优化同传翻译体验，翻译响应更快更流畅，流式语音识别与增量翻译协同实现超低延时同传翻译；大模型结合上下文推理，准确处理长句、口语及专业术语；声纹识别与说话人分离技术，清晰区分不同发言角色
- 优化耳机佩戴场景的语音翻译体验，支持声纹复刻播报，让旅行、商务及多人会议沟通更连贯、更高效
- 优化耳机佩戴场景的语音翻译体验，边听边译更快、更准。进一步提升翻译速度与准确度
- 在部分硬件支持的耳机上，新增连续三次敲击耳机或按捏耳机即可开启语音翻译，无需掏出手机；骨传导传感器与多麦克风矩阵协同，精准识别不同发言人，让多人同传更准确、更自然

## 设备互联
- 新增第三方相机接入 OPPO 互联生态，支持无感互联，仅需一次配对，相机开机靠近手机/平板即可自动发现，并通过流体云一键连接，设备互联更加便捷
- 新增 OPPO 互联-跨设备内容创作，支持在相册中直接查看外接设备中的照片和视频，同时支持第三方应用中直接选取外接设备中的照片和视频，无需导入或保存至本地即可预览、分享、编辑，跨设备创作更加高效

## 安全守护
- 新增 AI 换脸检测功能，实时检测视频通话中的 AI 换脸痕迹，有风险时及时提醒
- 优化 AI 通话防诈识别，结合 AI 合成语音识别与通话语义理解能力，实时检测通话风险，并在发现风险时及时提醒，通话更加安心

## 无障碍模式
- 新增 AI 实景对话无障碍模式（需开启系统 TalkBack 或第三方读屏软件），为视障用户提供更贴心的实景交互体验。针对无障碍场景优化大模型能力，基于真实场景进行更准确、更可信的客观内容描述，帮助用户更轻松地了解身边世界
- 新增 TalkBack 智能读屏功能（设置-辅助功能-无障碍-TalkBack-智能读屏），浏览应用界面时，即使第三方应用未提供无障碍功能，系统也可智能识别按钮、图片、图标等页面内容并进行语音播报，让读屏体验更加完整准确，帮助视障用户更轻松地使用更多应用

## 其他
- 新增多应用同时输出音频功能，并在设置中提供开关选项
- 优化 AI 网络体验，智能识别不同应用与使用场景，动态优化网络连接与双卡切换策略，在弱网、网络拥堵及游戏等场景下，带来更稳定、更流畅的上网体验
- 优化屏幕亮度调节算法，智能记忆亮度调节使用习惯，并自动适配屏幕亮度
- 优化系统部分场景声音与振动效果

- 新增会议笔记，支持会议录音实时转写，支持边听、边记、边拍等多模态会议记录，自动提取会议主题、核心观点、待办事项及责任人，一键生成结构化会议笔记
- 新增说想法功能，支持自然口述记录，AI 会保留原意，清理重复、停顿和口语表达，整理成更清楚的笔记，帮你快速保存灵感、想法与工作内容
- 新增支持导入文档、链接、图片等多种内容，AI 自动识别关键信息，提炼重点并生成结构化笔记。还能与已有知识建立关联，让外部资料逐步转化为可持续积累的个人知识资产
- 新增 AI 笔记助手，可基于笔记内容延展思考、关联历史记录，生成结构化笔记，也能围绕已有内容进行 AI 问答与创作，让零散信息逐步沉淀为知识

## AI 拍一拍
- 全新 AI 拍一拍，整合系统 AI 视觉能力，镜头一拍即可智能识别意图并推荐功能，一看即懂，一按即问，一步直达
- 新增超清文档扫描，支持快速扫描纸质文档，一键生成电子文档，记录资料更加便捷。支持极速连续扫描，连续拍摄无需等待；全新超清增强算法，智能优化文字、边缘与画质，还原更加清晰锐利的文档效果
- 支持文档版式感知提取，一键提取文档内容，智能保留标题、段落、表格等版式信息，让纸质文档快速转换为可编辑电子文档
- 支持扫描导出为常用办公文档格式，并支持多文档装订，一键合并多份扫描文件，文档整理更加高效
- 支持扫描一键发送至电脑等设备，扫描完成即可继续编辑或分享，跨设备办公更加高效
- 支持智能理解各类二维码内容，全面覆盖系统服务、第三方应用及网页场景，扫码支付、添加联系人、打开服务等操作一键即可完成
- 支持扫码快速连接 WLAN，更支持 AI 智能理解图片中的联网信息，即使 WLAN 名称与密码以文字形式展示，也能自动识别并完成连接
- 新增 AI 识万物，智能理解画面中的各类内容，一拍商品即可比价搜同款，一拍食物分析热量、营养及过敏信息，一拍护肤品展示功效并提供使用建议，让生活所见随拍随懂
- 整合系统拍照翻译，AI 智能理解图片中的文字内容，一拍即可完成精准翻译，轻松看懂菜单、路牌、说明书等外文信息

## AI 翻译
- 全新翻译应用，AI 重塑翻译体验，焕新界面设计，拍照翻译、语音翻译、文本翻译三大核心能力直达底部导航，切换更加便捷
- 支持更多大模型翻译语言（简体中文、英语、日语、韩语、马来语、越南语、泰语、德语、法语、印尼语），翻译结果更地道
- 优化同传翻译体验，翻译响应更快更流畅，流式语音识别与增量翻译协同实现超低延时同传翻译；大模型结合上下文推理，准确处理长句、口语及专业术语；声纹识别与说话人分离技术，清晰区分不同发言角色
- 优化耳机佩戴场景的语音翻译体验，支持声纹复刻播报，让旅行、商务及多人会议沟通更连贯、更高效
- 优化耳机佩戴场景的语音翻译体验，边听边译更快、更准。进一步提升翻译速度与准确度
- 在部分硬件支持的耳机上，新增连续三次敲击耳机或按捏耳机即可开启语音翻译，无需掏出手机；骨传导传感器与多麦克风矩阵协同，精准识别不同发言人，让多人同传更准确、更自然

## 设备互联
- 新增第三方相机接入 OPPO 互联生态，支持无感互联，仅需一次配对，相机开机靠近手机/平板即可自动发现，并通过流体云一键连接，设备互联更加便捷
- 新增 OPPO 互联-跨设备内容创作，支持在相册中直接查看外接设备中的照片和视频，同时支持第三方应用中直接选取外接设备中的照片和视频，无需导入或保存至本地即可预览、分享、编辑，跨设备创作更加高效

## 安全守护
- 新增 AI 换脸检测功能，实时检测视频通话中的 AI 换脸痕迹，有风险时及时提醒
- 优化 AI 通话防诈识别，结合 AI 合成语音识别与通话语义理解能力，实时检测通话风险，并在发现风险时及时提醒，通话更加安心

## 无障碍模式
- 新增 AI 实景对话无障碍模式（需开启系统 TalkBack 或第三方读屏软件），为视障用户提供更贴心的实景交互体验。针对无障碍场景优化大模型能力，基于真实场景进行更准确、更可信的客观内容描述，帮助用户更轻松地了解身边世界
- 新增 TalkBack 智能读屏功能（设置-辅助功能-无障碍-TalkBack-智能读屏），浏览应用界面时，即使第三方应用未提供无障碍功能，系统也可智能识别按钮、图片、图标等页面内容并进行语音播报，让读屏体验更加完整准确，帮助视障用户更轻松地使用更多应用

## 其他
- 新增多应用同时输出音频功能，并在设置中提供开关选项
- 优化 AI 网络体验，智能识别不同应用与使用场景，动态优化网络连接与双卡切换策略，在弱网、网络拥堵及游戏等场景下，带来更稳定、更流畅的上网体验
- 优化屏幕亮度调节算法，智能记忆亮度调节使用习惯，并自动适配屏幕亮度
- 优化系统部分场景声音与振动效果

# PLP120_17.0.0.109(CN01)

> 官方更新日志 · 来源: OTA descriptionInfo
> OTA 指纹: `PLP120_11.C.41_1410_202610051652`

## 流体设计，流动丝滑，鲜活自然
- 全新流体设计，为流畅而生的设计语言，流动丝滑，鲜活自然。流体设计以融合一体的状态衔接、柔和的动态节奏和鲜活的反馈体验，让每一次交互都自然发生
- 新增凝光视效，通过轻盈、亲和、圆润的材质设计，兼顾界面的可读性、通透性与视觉美观性
- 新增流体动效，界面与元素过渡支持流体融合效果，让元素无缝衔接、状态自然流转
- 新增柔性反馈系统，全局元素随操作自然拉伸、受力挤压、灵动回弹，光效随着意图与界面变化主动响应，以光传递状态、反馈与引导，让每一次操作都响应交互意图，更自然、更鲜活
- 全新一代极光引擎，新增融合渲染架构，光效与界面融合渲染，带来更高效的渲染性能，呈现更细腻连贯的流体动画与视觉效果
- 新增流体时钟效果，息屏、锁屏、桌面时钟无缝共享，如同天生一体，带来自然连贯的解锁体验
- 优化锁屏上滑解锁动效，以流体时钟为视觉锚点，图标以此为中心动态响应进场动效，让视觉焦点保持连续，实现从锁屏到桌面的动效一体性
- 新增锁屏通知下沉效果，卡片自然堆叠，优化通知状态切换递进效果和滑动回弹动效
- 新增锁屏时钟字体的响应效果，根据通知内容自适应尺寸显示，并保障时钟字体在最小尺寸时的可读性
- 优化锁屏小组件、锁屏底部快捷方式、锁屏岛胶囊的视觉、动画效果以及引入柔性反馈系统
- 优化锁屏密码盘视觉效果，优化出场递进动画，以及引入柔性反馈系统，提升交互响应速度
- 全新控制中心设计，新增按压凝光视效，按压反馈更生动；优化部分二级页面视觉与动画效果
- 全新通知中心设计，更轻盈通透的卡片材质，提升信息对比与可读性。新增按压凝光视效，按压反馈更生动
- 优化通知中心与控制中心切换动画效果，引入渐进式运动时差，并根据手势焦点与滑动速率动态调整元素运动，让切换更跟手、更自然，也更具流动感

## 流体设计，流动丝滑，鲜活自然

- 新增凝光视效，通过轻盈、亲和、圆润的材质设计，兼顾界面的可读性、通透性与视觉美观性

- 新增柔性反馈系统，全局元素随操作自然拉伸、受力挤压、灵动回弹，光效随着意图与界面变化主动响应，以光传递状态、反馈与引导，让每一次操作都响应交互意图，更自然、更鲜活

- 新增凝光视效，通过轻盈、亲和、圆润的材质设计，兼顾界面的可读性、通透性与视觉美观性

- 全新控制中心设计，新增按压凝光视效，按压反馈更生动；优化部分二级页面视觉与动画效果
- 全新通知中心设计，更轻盈通透的卡片材质，提升信息对比与可读性。新增按压凝光视效，按压反馈更生动
- 优化通知中心与控制中心切换动画效果，引入渐进式运动时差，并根据手势焦点与滑动速率动态调整元素运动，让切换更跟手、更自然，也更具流动感
- 新增山之道-实况天气，山之道主题支持实时显示当前天气，在桌面和锁屏沉浸式感受朝晴暮雨的自然变化
- 新增灵感主题-锁屏样式切换功能，支持在时钟、图文、相框样式间自由切换，轻松打造个性化锁屏界面（部分灵感主题支持）
- 新增 ColorOS 17 流体壁纸，解锁动画实时响应手势节奏，让壁纸流转更加自然，解锁更具沉浸感
- 优化速览界面进入动效，引入渐进式运动时差，让界面过渡更连贯、更具节奏感
- 新增横屏应用旋转动效，应用启动与退出过渡更自然，同时优化在有小窗挂起时的多窗口横竖屏无缝切换效果
- 流体云全面焕新，视觉如云般轻盈通透。凝光随手势自然流动，按压反馈清晰明确，让交互更直观、更有质感
- 新增闹钟、倒计时、计时器、OPPO 互传、来电等场景的流体云凝光视效，优化细节动效
- 优化音乐流体云卡片，引入凝光视效，播放进度凝光指引、切歌光效弥散涟漪，让播放反馈更灵动沉浸，并在锁屏及控制中心一致呈现
- 新增系统应用引入全新设计语言，视觉效果焕然一新，优化设置、系统更新、关于手机等界面设计
- 新增全局浮岛式导航设计，应用界面更加沉浸；导航切换新增流体融合过渡，让元素衔接更加自然

## 潮汐引擎
- 潮汐引擎全面升级，带来全新自研感知调度，优化系统内存调度策略，高内存负载下有效减少前台卡顿，降低后台应用误清理
- 新增记忆后台，通过端侧个人化建模，更懂你的意图，实现更精准、更智能的应用保活
- 新增应用小程序加速器，提升启动与运行效率，提升加载速度；多小程序并行运行时，动态调配系统资源，保障运行更加流畅

## 你的小布
- 新增全新小布唤醒动画，以拟人化形象自然回应，并加入语音文字动效，让交互更聚焦、更自然
- 优化小布连续对话体验，提升多轮对话中的上下文理解能力，更好理解前后信息，让连续交流更自然
- 升级小布意图理解能力，更准确识别问答与用机需求，提供更精准的回答和操作服务
- 升级旅行规划能力，结合小布记忆生成更懂你的结构化旅行攻略，并接入腾讯地图服务，让行程规划更个性、更便捷
- 新增一句话整理相册，支持通过自然语言快速找出想要的照片并创建图集，让照片整理更简单高效
- 新增小布与我，小布自动学习你的长期偏好，越来越懂你；同时支持自定义小布的人格风格，打造专属于你的小布
- 新增更多一键闪记场景，智能识别应用中联系人信息，联系人可一键添加，抢购/抢票界面闪记可一键创建秒抢闹钟，让信息快速转化为服务
- 新增一键闪记意图推荐，一键闪记后基于屏幕内容智能理解更多意图，推荐更多相关服务，一步直达所需

## AI 流体云
- 新增流体云融合导航，支持在流体云智能分阶段呈现步行、打车、地铁、公交导航信息，全程无缝接续（该功能支持百度地图、高德地图）
- 新增主动提醒，系统将感知你的行程节点，主动呈现乘车码、预计进站时间、实时站点信息、换乘提醒、到站下车提醒、出口信息等出行服务，让重要信息始终恰到好处
- 新增城市地标设计，途经部分城市地标时，流体云将呈现专属动态效果，让导航过程更具沉浸感，为每一段旅程增添更多惊喜
- 新增融合导航信息在锁屏岛实时呈现，无需解锁即可查看导航进度与关键信息
- 新增蜂群融合感知技术，通过与三方合作，融合多源环境感知、群体行为建模与端侧个性化学习能力，精准感知你所处环境与行程阶段，实现更精准、更主动、更个性化的智能服务

## 相册
- 新增 AI 修图师，通过自然语言描述修图想法，从光影、构图、色彩、人像等多维度协同优化，呈现更真实自然的修图效果
- 新增 AI 灵感模板推荐，智能理解照片内容与画面风格，主动推荐合适的创作模板，在 AI 修图师与相册创作页均可使用
- 新增 AI 参考图复刻，融合画面语义理解、风格特征提取与美学迁移能力，精准学习参考图风格，实现色彩、光影与美颜效果的自然迁移
- 新增达芬奇视觉理解大模型，融合画面语义理解、美学认知、风格特征学习与生成式优化能力，提供统一算法，实现真实、自然、富有美感的画面效果
- 优化相册回忆能力，通过端侧大模型智能理解照片中的人物、事件与时间关联，自动筛选更具故事性的照片，生成专属回忆影集
- 新增支持在相册中直接查看部分三方设备中的照片和视频，无需导入本地即可浏览、预览，所见即所得，跨设备内容查看更加便捷
- 新增支持三方应用中直接跨端选取部分三方设备中的照片和视频，无需保存至本地即可一键分享或编辑，跨设备创作更加高效

## AI 笔记
- 新增 AI 笔记应用，打造 AI 时代的知识笔记。不止帮你记录信息，更能理解、整理并连接知识，让每一次记录持续沉淀，逐步构建属于你的个人知识体系
- 新增会议笔记，支持会议录音实时转写，支持边听、边记、边拍等多模态会议记录，自动提取会议主题、核心观点、待办事项及责任人，一键生成结构化会议笔记
- 新增说想法功能，支持自然口述记录，AI 会保留原意，清理重复、停顿和口语表达，整理成更清楚的笔记，帮你快速保存灵感、想法与工作内容
- 新增支持导入文档、链接、图片等多种内容，AI 自动识别关键信息，提炼重点并生成结构化笔记。还能与已有知识建立关联，让外部资料逐步转化为可持续积累的个人知识资产
- 新增 AI 笔记助手，可基于笔记内容延展思考、关联历史记录，生成结构化笔记，也能围绕已有内容进行 AI 问答与创作，让零散信息逐步沉淀为知识

## AI 拍一拍
- 全新 AI 拍一拍，整合系统 AI 视觉能力，镜头一拍即可智能识别意图并推荐功能，一看即懂，一按即问，一步直达
- 新增超清文档扫描，支持快速扫描纸质文档，一键生成电子文档，记录资料更加便捷。支持极速连续扫描，连续拍摄无需等待；全新超清增强算法，智能优化文字、边缘与画质，还原更加清晰锐利的文档效果
- 支持文档版式感知提取，一键提取文档内容，智能保留标题、段落、表格等版式信息，让纸质文档快速转换为可编辑电子文档
- 支持扫描导出为常用办公文档格式，并支持多文档装订，一键合并多份扫描文件，文档整理更加高效
- 支持扫描一键发送至电脑等设备，扫描完成即可继续编辑或分享，跨设备办公更加高效
- 支持智能理解各类二维码内容，全面覆盖系统服务、第三方应用及网页场景，扫码支付、添加联系人、打开服务等操作一键即可完成
- 支持扫码快速连接 WLAN，更支持 AI 智能理解图片中的联网信息，即使 WLAN 名称与密码以文字形式展示，也能自动识别并完成连接
- 新增 AI 识万物，智能理解画面中的各类内容，一拍商品即可比价搜同款，一拍食物分析热量、营养及过敏信息，一拍护肤品展示功效并提供使用建议，让生活所见随拍随懂
- 整合系统拍照翻译，AI 智能理解图片中的文字内容，一拍即可完成精准翻译，轻松看懂菜单、路牌、说明书等外文信息
- 新增支持将手机快捷键设置为 AI 拍一拍（仅支持配备快捷键的机型），一键快速开启

## AI 翻译
- 全新翻译应用，AI 重塑翻译体验，焕新界面设计，拍照翻译、语音翻译、文本翻译三大核心能力直达底部导航，切换更加便捷
- 支持更多大模型翻译语言（简体中文、英语、日语、韩语、马来语、越南语、泰语、德语、法语、印尼语），翻译结果更地道
- 优化同传翻译体验，翻译响应更快更流畅，流式语音识别与增量翻译协同实现超低延时同传翻译；大模型结合上下文推理，准确处理长句、口语及专业术语；声纹识别与说话人分离技术，清晰区分不同发言角色
- 优化耳机佩戴场景的语音翻译体验，支持声纹复刻播报，让旅行、商务及多人会议沟通更连贯、更高效
- 优化耳机佩戴场景的语音翻译体验，边听边译更快、更准。进一步提升翻译速度与准确度
- 在部分硬件支持的耳机上，新增连续三次敲击耳机或按捏耳机即可开启语音翻译，无需掏出手机；骨传导传感器与多麦克风矩阵协同，精准识别不同发言人，让多人同传更准确、更自然

## 设备互联
- 新增第三方相机接入 OPPO 互联生态，支持无感互联，仅需一次配对，相机开机靠近手机/平板即可自动发现，并通过流体云一键连接，设备互联更加便捷
- 新增 OPPO 互联-跨设备内容创作，支持在相册中直接查看外接设备中的照片和视频，同时支持第三方应用中直接选取外接设备中的照片和视频，无需导入或保存至本地即可预览、分享、编辑，跨设备创作更加高效

## 安全守护
- 新增 AI 换脸检测功能，实时检测视频通话中的 AI 换脸痕迹，有风险时及时提醒
- 优化 AI 通话防诈识别，结合 AI 合成语音识别与通话语义理解能力，实时检测通话风险，并在发现风险时及时提醒，通话更加安心

## 无障碍模式
- 新增 AI 实景对话无障碍模式（需开启系统 TalkBack 或第三方读屏软件），为视障用户提供更贴心的实景交互体验。针对无障碍场景优化大模型能力，基于真实场景进行更准确、更可信的客观内容描述，帮助用户更轻松地了解身边世界
- 新增 TalkBack 智能读屏功能（设置-辅助功能-无障碍-TalkBack-智能读屏），浏览应用界面时，即使第三方应用未提供无障碍功能，系统也可智能识别按钮、图片、图标等页面内容并进行语音播报，让读屏体验更加完整准确，帮助视障用户更轻松地使用更多应用

## 其他
- 新增多应用同时输出音频功能，并在设置中提供开关选项
- 优化 AI 网络体验，智能识别不同应用与使用场景，动态优化网络连接与双卡切换策略，在弱网、网络拥堵及游戏等场景下，带来更稳定、更流畅的上网体验
- 优化屏幕亮度调节算法，智能记忆亮度调节使用习惯，并自动适配屏幕亮度
- 优化系统部分场景声音与振动效果

You can now view photos and videos from certain third-party devices directly in Photos, and browse and preview them without importing them to your device, making cross-device content viewing more convenient.
You can now select photos and videos directly from certain third-party devices in third-party apps, and share or edit them with a single tap without first saving them locally, making cross-device creation more efficient.

### OSee

Introduces OSee, which integrates the system's AI vision capabilities. Take a photo, and it will intelligently understand your intent and recommend relevant features.
Adds ultra-clear document scanning, enabling you to quickly scan paper documents and generate electronic documents with one tap, making it easier to save and manage your documents. The feature also supports ultra-fast continuous scanning with no waiting between consecutive scans. The all-new AI Hyper Clarity algorithm intelligently optimizes text, edges, and image quality to deliver clearer, sharper document scans.
Supports one-tap, layout-aware document extraction that intelligently preserves headings, paragraphs, tables, and other formatting elements, quickly converting paper documents into editable electronic documents.
Supports scanning and exporting to PDF, as well as merging multiple documents. Merge multiple scanned files with one tap for more efficient document organization.
Supports scanning and one-tap sending to PCs and other devices. After scanning, you can continue editing or sharing, making cross-device work more efficient.
Supports intelligent recognition of various QR code content across system services, third-party apps, and webpages. Scan to pay, add contacts, open services, and more with a single tap.
Integrates the system's Snap & Translate feature. AI intelligently understands text in images and provides accurate translations in a single shot, making it easy to read menus, road signs, manuals, and other foreign-language content.

### AI Translate

Introduces an all-new Translate app with an AI-enhanced translation experience and refreshed interface design. The three core capabilities—photo translation, voice translation, and text translation—are now directly accessible from the bottom navigation, making it easier to switch between them.
Supports more languages for AI model-powered translation (Simplified Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Malay, Vietnamese, Thai, German, French, and Indonesian), delivering more natural translations.
Improves the real-time simultaneous translation experience with faster, smoother responses. Streaming speech recognition and incremental translation work together to achieve ultra-low latency. Large language models use contextual reasoning to accurately handle long sentences, colloquial speech, and professional terms, while voiceprint recognition and speaker separation clearly distinguish between different speakers.
Improves voice translation when using earphones, supporting voice-cloned playback to make communication during travel, business, and multi-person meetings more seamless and efficient.
Improves voice translation when using earphones, making translation faster and more accurate.
You can now triple-tap or pinch supported earbuds to start voice translation without taking out your phone. The bone-conduction sensor works with the multi-microphone array to accurately identify different speakers, making multi-person simultaneous translation more accurate and natural.

### Device Connect

Adds third-party camera support to the O+ Connect ecosystem, enabling seamless connectivity with one-time pairing. Once paired, your camera is automatically detected when powered on and placed near your phone or tablet, and connects with a single tap through Live Alerts, making cross-device connectivity more effortless.

Adds support for simultaneous audio output from multiple apps, with a toggle switch available in Settings.
Improves the AI network experience by intelligently identifying apps and usage scenarios and dynamically optimizing internet connections and dual-SIM switching strategies for a more stable, smoother online experience under weak network conditions, network congestion, and during gaming.
Improves the screen brightness adjustment algorithm to learn your brightness adjustment habits and automatically adjust screen brightness accordingly.

# RMX5210_17.0.0.105(EX01)

> 官方更新日志 · 来源: 官方 changelog 页面
> OTA 指纹: `RMX5210_11.C.28_1280_202610181204`
> 原文: https://gauss-componentotamanual.allawnofs.com/remove-4c6b253ea3a8af6678c663901785a1b1/component-ota/26/10/22/71a1296c0b764afb93bab88690de39f5.html

### Fluid design. Smooth in motion, vivid by nature.

- Introduces an all-new fluid design, crafted for seamless interactions. Smooth in motion, vivid by nature. With seamlessly integrated state transitions, gentle motion rhythms, and lively feedback, the fluid design makes every interaction feel natural.
- Adds responsive light effects that balance readability, transparency, and visual aesthetics in a lightweight, friendly, rounded design.
- Adds fluid animations. Screen and element transitions now feature fluid merging effects, creating seamless connections between elements and more natural transitions between states.
- Adds a flexible feedback system that enables interface elements to naturally stretch, compress under pressure, and rebound dynamically in response to user interactions, while light effects actively respond to user intent and interface changes to convey status, feedback, and guidance through light, making every interaction feel more responsive and creating a more natural, vivid experience.
- Introduces the next-generation Luminous Rendering Engine with a new fused rendering architecture that renders light effects and the user interface together, delivering greater rendering efficiency and more refined, seamless fluid animations and visuals.
- Adds a fluid clock effect that seamlessly carries the clock across the Always-On Display, Lock screen, and Home screen, creating a natural, cohesive unlocking experience.
- Improves the Lock screen swipe-up unlock animation. App icons now animate into view with the fluid clock as a visual anchor, creating a seamless transition from the Lock screen to the Home screen.
- Adds a downward collapse effect for Lock screen notifications, allowing notification cards to stack naturally, and improves the progressive transitions and swipe-rebound animations for notification display changes.
- Adds responsive behavior to the Lock screen clock font, dynamically adjusting its size based on notification content while ensuring readability at the minimum size.
- Improves the visuals and animations of Lock screen widgets, bottom shortcuts, and Live Space capsules, with a new flexible feedback system applied to these elements.
- Improves the Lock screen password keypad visuals by optimizing the progressive entry animation and introducing a flexible feedback system for more responsive interactions.
- Introduces a new Quick Settings design with responsive light effects for tap interactions, providing more vivid feedback, and improves the visuals and animations on certain secondary pages.
- Redesigns the notification drawer with a lighter, more translucent card design, enhancing information contrast and readability. Adds responsive light effects for tap interactions, making the feedback more vivid.
- Improves the transition animation between the notification drawer and Quick Settings by introducing a sequential motion effect and dynamically adjusting element movement based on gesture focus and swipe speed, making transitions more responsive, natural, and fluid.
- The Sublime Grandeur theme wallpapers now display real-time local weather, so you can check the latest weather information directly from the Home screen and Lock screen.
- Adds Lock screen style switching for Flux themes, allowing you to freely switch between clock, graphic-and-text, and photo frame styles to easily create a personalized Lock screen (available for select Flux themes).
- Adds ColorOS 17 fluid wallpapers, with unlock animations that respond to the rhythm of your gestures in real time, making wallpaper switching more natural and device unlocking more immersive.
- Adds rotation animations for apps running in landscape mode to make app launch and exit transitions more natural, and improves switching between landscape and portrait modes when a mini window is present on the screen for a more seamless experience.
- Refreshes Live Alerts with light, translucent visuals inspired by clouds. Responsive light effects flow naturally with your gestures, while clear, precise tap feedback makes interactions more intuitive and refined.
- Adds responsive light effects to Live Alerts for alarms, countdowns, timers, realme Share, and other scenarios, with refined animation details.
- Improves music Live Alerts with responsive light effects, including light effects that guide playback progress and diffusing ripple effects when switching songs, making playback feedback more dynamic and immersive while providing a consistent visual experience across the Lock screen and Quick Settings.
- Introduces a brand-new design language to system apps, refreshing their look, and improves the designs of the Settings, System & update, About device, and other screens.
- Introduces a new system-wide floating-island navigation design for a more immersive app experience, with fluid merging effects when switching between navigation items for more seamless connections between elements.

### Laminar Flow Engine

- Upgrades Laminar Flow Engine with a new context-aware scheduling system, optimizing memory management to effectively reduce foreground lag under high memory load and prevent unnecessary background app closures.
- Introduces smarter background app management that uses on-device personalized modeling to better understand your intentions and keep the right apps running in the background more intelligently.

### Mind Space

- Adds the Travel collection, which automatically organizes your trip locations into a personalized travel map.
- Improves memory collections to generate structured image-and-text summaries, making key information easier to browse and understand at a glance.

### Photos

- Improves the Memories feature in Photos by using on-device AI models to intelligently understand the relationships between people, events, and time in photos, automatically selecting more story-rich photos and creating personalized memory albums.
- You can now view photos and videos from certain third-party devices directly in Photos, and browse and preview them without importing them to your device, making cross-device content viewing more convenient.
- You can now select photos and videos directly from certain third-party devices in third-party apps, and share or edit them with a single tap without first saving them locally, making cross-device creation more efficient.

### OSee

- Introduces OSee, which integrates the system's AI vision capabilities. Take a photo, and it will intelligently understand your intent and recommend relevant features.
- Adds ultra-clear document scanning, enabling you to quickly scan paper documents and generate electronic documents with one tap, making it easier to save and manage your documents. The feature also supports ultra-fast continuous scanning with no waiting between consecutive scans. The all-new AI Hyper Clarity algorithm intelligently optimizes text, edges, and image quality to deliver clearer, sharper document scans.
- Supports one-tap, layout-aware document extraction that intelligently preserves headings, paragraphs, tables, and other formatting elements, quickly converting paper documents into editable electronic documents.
- Supports scanning and exporting to PDF, as well as merging multiple documents. Merge multiple scanned files with one tap for more efficient document organization.
- Supports intelligent recognition of various QR code content across system services, third-party apps, and webpages. Scan to pay, add contacts, open services, and more with a single tap.
- Integrates the system's Snap & Translate feature. AI intelligently understands text in images and provides accurate translations in a single shot, making it easy to read menus, road signs, manuals, and other foreign-language content.

### AI Translate

- Introduces an all-new Translate app with an AI-enhanced translation experience and refreshed interface design. The three core capabilities—photo translation, voice translation, and text translation—are now directly accessible from the bottom navigation, making it easier to switch between them.
- Supports more languages for AI model-powered translation (Simplified Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Malay, Vietnamese, Thai, German, French, and Indonesian), delivering more natural translations.
- Improves the real-time simultaneous translation experience with faster, smoother responses. Streaming speech recognition and incremental translation work together to achieve ultra-low latency. Large language models use contextual reasoning to accurately handle long sentences, colloquial speech, and professional terms, while voiceprint recognition and speaker separation clearly distinguish between different speakers.
- Improves voice translation when using earphones, supporting voice-cloned playback to make communication during travel, business, and multi-person meetings more seamless and efficient.
- Improves voice translation when using earphones, making translation faster and more accurate.
- You can now triple-tap or pinch supported earbuds to start voice translation without taking out your phone. The bone-conduction sensor works with the multi-microphone array to accurately identify different speakers, making multi-person simultaneous translation more accurate and natural.

### Device Connect

- Adds third-party camera support to the O+ Connect ecosystem, enabling seamless connectivity with one-time pairing. Once paired, your camera is automatically detected when powered on and placed near your phone or tablet, and connects with a single tap through Live Alerts, making cross-device connectivity more effortless.

### Other

- Adds support for simultaneous audio output from multiple apps, with a toggle switch available in Settings.
- Improves the AI network experience by intelligently identifying apps and usage scenarios and dynamically optimizing internet connections and dual-SIM switching strategies for a more stable, smoother online experience under weak network conditions, network congestion, and during gaming.
- Improves the screen brightness adjustment algorithm to learn your brightness adjustment habits and automatically adjust screen brightness accordingly.
- Improves system sounds and vibration effects in certain scenarios.
